$comment: Install docs and the brand layer, pulled at build time so this site never
keeps a second copy of something that is canonical elsewhere. Bump a `ref`
when the source tags a release this site should pick up — `make sync` then
refreshes the copies and the build uses them.
Cadasto/docs-theme files written onto their live MkDocs paths. Those
destinations are gitignored. `ref` is the commit a release tag points
at rather than the tag itself: two of these files are Jinja templates
that the build executes, docs-site.yml rebuilds weekly on a schedule,
and a tag can be moved — so a tag would let the published site change
with nothing in this repository recording it. To pick up a brand
release, resolve its tag to a commit and replace `ref`:
(use that, not git/ref/tags — for an annotated tag the latter
returns the tag object's sha, which raw.githubusercontent 404s.)
`ref_tag` is documentation only; the sync script does not read it.
